action_text: That sounds incredibly challenging. Dealing with work stress on top of personal issues seems overwhelming. Have you considered seeking any outside support?
linkage_rule: cross-turn: a supporter suggestion turn ('you could/might/may/should try ...' or 'have you tried/considered ...') followed, within 8 turn-idx and the same session, by a seeker turn containing an explicit anaphoric reference (that/it/this/what you said/suggested/mentioned/told me), at least one shared non-stopword content word (length >= 4) with the suggestion turn, and an explicit result-relation clause (memory/me.py's _RESULT_RELATION_PATTERNS) outside any question context. Excluded if more than one qualifying suggestion turn exists between the antecedent and the result turn (competing antecedent).
result_text: It helps knowing there's someone I can lean on. I'll think more seriously about getting support.
